# Tit for Tat

> Tit for Tat is a mobile app for any two people to split duties fairly. It logs
> morning, day and evening slots, shows each year's history at a glance, and
> keeps both partners in sync automatically via iCloud. Currently in TestFlight beta.

What it does:

- Logs morning, day and evening slots for each partner.
- Displays each year's history so both partners can see the split at a glance.
- Syncs automatically between devices via iCloud — no account required.

What it isn't: a general-purpose scheduling or calendar app. There are no reminders,
no third-party sharing, and no server-side data storage.
